items.title: Cummins (CMI) Just Gave Investors Something To Think About
items.summary: Cummins (CMI) has just put a spotlight on its heavy equipment ambitions by unveiling the S29 mining engine in China, a high horsepower, fuel flexible platform aimed at large haul trucks and excavators. Despite unveiling the S29 and reporting third quarter sales of US$9,438 million with net income of US$1,140 million earlier this month, Cummins shares have moved sharply lower.
